rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of BLACK TORTOISE / XUANWU, the Chinese spiritual constellation symbol of a TURTLE INTERTWINED WITH A SNAKE [black-tortoise-c01,black-tortoise-c08], rendered as living creatures, not a statue, carving, toy or ornamental plaque.
ANATOMY: exactly ONE living BLACK/DARK TURTLE with ONE normal reptilian turtle HEAD, TWO eyes, blunt horny beak, a heavy domed scute SHELL and FOUR short clawed LEGS. Exactly ONE long coherent LIMBLESS SNAKE wraps across and around its shell/body, one snake head/two eyes and one continuous tail. The snake has no wings, horns, extra heads, legs, cobra hood or dragon whiskers. Turtle has no dragon head, mammal teeth, spines or extra legs. Both heads clearly separated and counted. Intimate coils visibly INTERTWINE with shell [black-tortoise-c01].
POWER: no documented elemental power; no ice blasts, controlling water, celestial beams or glowing aura. Sacred authority through intertwined turtle/snake anatomy and living forward motion only. Both spiritual creatures symbolize longevity [black-tortoise-c08].
MOMENT: the turtle advances directly toward the low viewer, ONE forefoot lifted and the other planted against rough stone, head/neck thrust forward beneath the shell. One coherent snake coil grips across its shell, and the single snake head rises BESIDE and ABOVE the turtle's head facing viewer, tongue flicking. All motion is bodily and physical; small grit shifts under a planted forefoot.
COMPOSITION: direct ground-level three-quarter frontal close scene, turtle face large at lower center, snake head higher to one side, shell behind fills upper half; four legs placed coherently, hind legs partly beneath shell. Full two heads inside square.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low CLOSE perspective; turtle head, shell and snake head dominate image, no unsupported giant-size claim and no people/buildings as scale reference. LIGHT & WEATHER: one cold low winter light shaft on wet dark shell, deep warm walnut shadows, dull aged-gold rim on real scales, ordinary frost and breath-like natural air haze without colored glow. SURFACE: rough living scute shell, damp dark reptilian skin, tactile snake scales, ordinary mud/frost, rich painterly brush texture. SETTING: plain dark cold stone/ground with small patches of frost, editorial expression of northern/winter association [black-tortoise-c03,black-tortoise-c04]; no invented named mountain, palace or cosmic power. MOOD: imposing ancient sacred guardian, not a cute turtle or ordinary pet; two living animals feel purposeful and authoritative. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudo-script, logos, frame, border, watermark, signature, gore, nudity, human figure, statues, extra heads/eyes/limbs/tails, dragon morphology, aura, neon, floating runes, energy ribbons or design borrowed from film/game/anime/comic.
depicted_variant: Living dark turtle intertwined with one coherent snake, advancing toward low viewer on winter-frosted ground.

No invented elemental magic; sacred authority through living bodily action of documented spiritual turtle/snake.

aura: The sacred living turtle/snake conjunction (black-tortoise-c01/c08) dominates through close bodily advance; northern/winter association (c03/c04) informs ordinary frost without elemental magic.
artistic_choices: Living animal conjunction rather than sculpture/ornament; no humanized Xuanwu king or separate generals imported from novel variant.
Dark shell/skin, normal turtle scutes and snake scale patterns are editorial biological textures around documented turtle/snake form.
Normal size and close camera; no giant-body assertion or elemental power. Winter frost, low light and plain rocks are editorial association-based setting, not researched literal habitat.
A chosen for direct two-head confrontation and clear intertwining; B distinct diagonal turn/rock bracing retained.
